verdict.rationale: PowerShell wrote its own path to the HKCU mscfile shell open command registry key, then launched eventvwr.exe, which auto-elevates and reads that key. The elevated eventvwr.exe then spawned a High-integrity PowerShell, which is the known Event Viewer UAC bypass. The CallTrace and full-access handle (0x001fffff) on eventvwr.exe fit the same pattern.
